title: 📌 Even the King Cobra must shed its past to grow.What are you still holding on to? 🌿
description:
This King Cobra isn’t sick… it’s transforming.
(3–6s)
Its eyes turn blue… it can barely see.
(6–10s)
Then it rubs, pushes… and sheds its old skin—like peeling off a past it has outgrown.
(10–13s)
Every scar, every parasite… gone.
(13–15s)
Growth isn’t adding more. It’s learning what to let go.
📌 Caption
Even the King Cobra must shed its past to grow.
What are you still holding on to? 🌿
📝 Description
This is how a King Cobra renews itself — through a process called shedding (ecdysis).
From cloudy “blue” eyes to peeling off its old skin like a sock, it’s one of nature’s most fascinating transformations.
Sometimes growth isn’t about gaining more… but releasing what no longer serves you.
